property_summary: In the reference C, setL1BlockValues never modifies state, so c.batcherHash() always remains bytes32(0) regardless of the _batcherHash argument; the mutant assigns _batcherHash, so for any nonzero fuzzed _batcherHash the getter returns a nonzero value, breaking the invariant.
change_summary: Insert `batcherHash = _batcherHash;` after the require so the public getter batcherHash() returns the passed value.
